programme.notes: Admissions questions answered from the university-wide undergraduate admissions pages (owner ruling for US universities). Official domain is illinois.edu (list row says uiuc.edu).

english.notes: Test required, minimum not published for first-year applicants: 'If you did not complete Grades 10-12 in an approved English-speaking country, you must submit one of the following test scores: TOEFL IELTS Duolingo English Test ACT* SAT*' (https://www.admissions.illinois.edu/international-requirements/). Published minimums on that site are for transfer applicants only.

gpa.notes: No published GPA minimum for first-year applicants; holistic review (Grainger scholarship FAQ mentions 'high school GPA and rigor' as review inputs, prose).

deadline.quote: Regular Deadline Jan 5 Standard timeline for full consideration.
deadline.notes: First-year timeline, applies to international first-year applicants too; Early Action Nov 1 (non-binding). The page prints no year: 2027-01-05 is the fall 2027 cycle by inference.

value.population: international, Grainger Engineering rate (all Grainger majors incl. CS), entry Summer 2026 - Spring 2027

tuition.notes: Columns: Resident / Nonresident / International; academic-year rate, guaranteed for the entry cohort. The 2027/28 entry rate is not published yet. Fees and indirect costs are extra.

scholarship_exists.quote: Merit-based scholarships are awarded based on high academic achievement and potential for success.
scholarship_exists.notes: Incoming first-years are considered automatically via the admission application. Need-based aid is not available to international undergraduates (admissions financial-aid page).
